editorial:
You get three heroes who suddenly swap places every time they use their powers, which makes for a fun and chaotic ride. R. astronaut, and Kamala Khan is the excited super-fan from Jersey City. Their powers get tangled together, so they have to learn to work as a team while chasing a Kree revolutionary who wants to steal resources from other worlds. The vibe is bright, fast, and full of humor, with a lot of heart between the three leads.

The action is colorful and quick, and the chemistry between the three women is the best part. Iman Vellani steals scenes as Kamala, and the movie moves fast enough that you rarely get bored. On the downside, the story can feel rushed and some side plots get little time. Still, if you want a light, fun superhero movie, this is a good pick.
endingExplained: In the final battle, the trio learns to swap powers on purpose to beat the Kree villain. Carol destroys the wormhole network to stop the threat, but the blast sends Monica into another universe. Kamala goes home inspired and starts recruiting young heroes for a new team. Carol stays in space to watch over things, while Monica is stuck in a different reality. The twist is that Monica meets alternate versions of heroes, hinting at bigger multiverse stories ahead.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves light superhero team-ups and colorful action.
